help_modal_subtitle: From everyday community living to offline disaster relief & AI integration
help_basics_concept_desc: tossa is an ultra-lightweight, Cloudflare-native CMS designed to bridge everyday cafes, shops, and community events with urgent disaster relief boards (shelters, water, food) through an organically emergent vocabulary.
help_basics_exif_desc: Upload photos directly from your phone. EXIF GPS coordinates are extracted to automatically pin the location on the map, compressed to 1200px WebP for lightning-fast posting even over 3G/degraded networks.
help_basics_c2pa_desc: Hardware cryptographic signatures (C2PA/JUMBF) verify that photos are genuinely captured and untampered. EXIF capture timestamps prevent re-sharing stale or outdated crisis information.
help_basics_status_desc: Anyone on the ground can update facility statuses (Available, Crowded, Low Stock, Closed) with a single tap, keeping disaster information accurate in real time.
help_basics_verify_desc: Tap 'Verify on Site' to vouch for active posts. Official government and media domains automatically receive trust badges.
help_disaster_concept_desc: Engineered to keep functioning even during total cell tower blackout or base station failures through local cache and peer-to-peer relay.
help_disaster_hud_desc: Activate navigation to shelters or water points to display real-time straight-line distance countdown and an interactive compass needle synchronized with device orientation sensors.
help_disaster_qr_desc: Compress and render any post as an offline QR code. Nearby devices can scan the screen using camera or screenshot upload to import disaster posts with zero internet connection.
help_disaster_push_desc: Receive urgent disaster alerts, evacuation announcements, and incoming E2EE messages on your device lock screen even when the browser is closed.
help_security_concept_desc: No passwords or emails are ever collected. Device biometrics and cutting-edge cryptography protect users and emergency responders.
help_security_passkey_desc: Log in effortlessly with Touch ID, Face ID, or Windows Hello. Completely immune to phishing and credential stuffing attacks.
help_security_e2ee_desc: Hardware-backed WebAuthn PRF and Web Crypto API (AES-GCM-256 + ECDH P-256) ensure that private inquiries cannot be read even by server operators.
help_security_edge_desc: Enforced with strict Content Security Policy, 2MB payload body limits, and sliding-window edge rate limiting against automated spam and DoS attacks.
help_ai_mcp_desc: Connect AI tools like Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Gemini CLI to tossa (/mcp) to query shelters, search relief supplies, generate disaster briefings, and submit field reports using natural language.
